metadata.subject: Physics
metadata.topic: Newton's Laws — Linear Momentum, Conservation, and Acceleration
metadata.caribbean_note: Context: collision on the Sir George Walter Highway — a real road in Antigua and Barbuda, named after a local politician

question.name: CSEC Phy Jan 2022 Q4b/c — Momentum Conservation and Acceleration
question.text:
A truck, of mass 945 kg, heading west on the Sir George Walter Highway, slammed head-on at 20 m s⁻¹ into a car of mass 630 kg, heading east.

Both vehicles came to rest after the collision.

In a separate scenario, a car's velocity increases from 20 m s⁻¹ to 45 m s⁻¹ in 10 s.
question.general_feedback:
Q4b(i) — Momentum of truck:
p = mv = 945 × 20 = 18 900 kg m s⁻¹ (west)

Q4b(ii) — Initial velocity of car:
Conservation of momentum: p_truck + p_car = 0 (both at rest after collision)
p_car = −p_truck = 18 900 kg m s⁻¹ (east)
v_car = p_car / m_car = 18 900 / 630 = 30 m s⁻¹ (east)

Q4c — Acceleration of car:
a = Δv / t = (45 − 20) / 10 = 25 / 10 = 2.5 m s⁻²

steps.label:
Given (collision): Truck: m = 945 kg, v = 20 m s⁻¹ west  |  Car: m = 630 kg, v = ? east  |  After: both at rest
Given (acceleration): v₁ = 20 m s⁻¹, v₂ = 45 m s⁻¹, t = 10 s
Formulas: p = mv    Σp(before) = Σp(after)    a = Δv/t
Q4b(i) — Calculate the initial momentum of the truck. (2 marks)
Q4b(ii) — Using conservation of momentum, calculate the initial velocity of the car. (4 marks)
Q4c — Calculate the acceleration of the car whose velocity increases from 20 to 45 m s⁻¹ in 10 s. (3 marks)

fields.label: Momentum of truck p = _____ kg m s⁻¹
fields.diagnostic_hint: p = m × v = 945 × 20 = 18 900 kg m s⁻¹ (west)

error_codes.SC_CALCULATION_ERROR: p = mass × velocity = 945 × 20 = 18 900 kg m s⁻¹.
error_codes.SC_FORMULA_SELECTION_ERROR: Linear momentum: p = mv. Multiply mass by velocity.

fields.label: Momentum of car (before collision) p_car = _____ kg m s⁻¹
fields.diagnostic_hint: Both at rest → total momentum = 0. So p_car must equal p_truck in magnitude: p_car = 18 900 kg m s⁻¹ (east)

error_codes.SC_METHOD_ERROR: Conservation of momentum: p_total before = p_total after. After = 0 (both at rest). So p_truck (west) + p_car (east) = 0 → p_car = 18 900 kg m s⁻¹ east.

fields.label: Initial velocity of car v_car = _____ m s⁻¹

error_codes.SC_FORMULA_SELECTION_ERROR: Rearrange p = mv to get v = p/m = 18 900 / 630 = 30 m s⁻¹.

fields.label: Change in velocity Δv = _____ m s⁻¹

error_codes.SC_CALCULATION_ERROR: Δv = final velocity − initial velocity = 45 − 20 = 25 m s⁻¹.

error_codes.SC_FORMULA_SELECTION_ERROR: Acceleration formula: a = (v₂ − v₁) / t. Divide change in velocity by time.
